// diagnostic

E1253

Inline dependency `{name}#{selector}` didn't resolve.

What

Inline dependency `{name}#{selector}` didn't resolve.

Why

A manifest-less script's `use {name}#{selector};` resolves from a local copy under `.jet/inline-deps/{name}/`, and only `jet run` and `jet fetch --lock` fetch a package no local copy knows from the configured package registry.

Fix

Run the script with `jet run`, which fetches and locks `{name}` on its first run, or commit a copy at `.jet/inline-deps/{name}/<version>/`.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E1253: tests/ui/inline_dep_unresolved.stderr.

Error [jet.UnresolvedInlineDependency]: Inline dependency `ghostpkg#1.0.0` didn't resolve
  --> tests/ui/inline_dep_unresolved.jet:3:13
    |
  3 | use ghostpkg#1.0.0
    |             ^^^^^^
 Why: No local copy under `.jet/inline-deps/ghostpkg/` holds `ghostpkg`, and only `jet run` and `jet fetch --lock` fetch a missing inline dependency.
 Fix: Run the script with `jet run`, which fetches and locks `ghostpkg` from the configured package registry on its first run, or commit a copy at `.jet/inline-deps/ghostpkg/<version>/`.
